sentences.text: Appearance:
(SHRI SAMEER KUMAR SHRIVASTAVA, LEARNED COUNSEL FOR THE  PETITIONER)

. 
 (SHRI SUSHANT TIWARI - P.P.- APPEARING ON BEHALF OF  ADVOCATE GENERAL.
ORDER The applicant has filed this First application u/S 439, Cr.P.C. for grant of bail.
The applicant has been arrested by Police Station Deepankheda, District Vidisha in connection with crime No. 18/2024 registered for the offence punishable under Section 376, 450, 354-A of IPC.
Learned counsel for the applicant argued that applicant is an innocent person and has been falsely implicated.
He further argued that applicant is the only earning member of his family.
The entire prosecution story is highly improbable.

As per allegations, incident of rape was committed by the applicant in the house of the complainant at afternoon, however, there is no evidence to show that the prosecutrix has resisted or raised any alarm while she was being sexually assaulted.
As per prosecution story, after incident, brother-in-law of the prosecutrix namely Sazid arrived at the spot and saw the applicant Imran was running away from the spot.

Thereafter, he informed about the same to the 2 MCRC-23385-2024 husband of the prosecutrix and after four days of the incident,
FIR was lodged, but no plausible explanation has been put forth by the prosecution in regard to delay in lodging FIR.
Prosecutrix is a major married woman having five children.
Case is medically belied.
At the most, this is a case of consensual sexual relationship between two major persons.
The applicant is in custody since 30/04/2024.
Investigation stands completed by filing of the charge sheet and further custodial interrogation of the applicant may not be required.
The applicant is permanent resident of District Vidisha.
Conclusion of trial is likely to take time and there is no likelihood of his absconsion, if released on bail.
On these grounds, he prays for grant of bail to the applicant.

sentences.text: On the other hand, learned State counsel vehemently opposed the application and prayed for its rejection.
Heard learned counsel for the rival parties and perused the case diary available on record.

Considering the overall facts and circumstances of the case, but without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, this application is allowed and it is directed that the applicant be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs. 50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with two local solvent sureties in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court/committal Court.
E- copy of this order be sent to the trial Court concerned for compliance, if possible, by the office of this Court.
Certified copy as per rules.
